command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "fly-foreground-diag.py"
@'
import ctypes as c
import ctypes.wintypes as W
import os
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.GetForegroundWindow.restype=W.HWND
u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.GetWindowTextW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.LPWSTR,c.c_int]
def info(hwnd):
    pid=W.DWORD()
    if hwnd:u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd,c.byref(pid))
    title=c.create_unicode_buffer(700)
    if hwnd:u.GetWindowTextW(hwnd,title,len(title))
    return int(hwnd or 0),int(pid.value),title.value
fg=u.GetForegroundWindow()
print("FOREGROUND_DIAG",info(fg),flush=True)
visible=[]
@CALL
def cb(hwnd,_):
    if u.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
        h,p,t=info(hwnd)
        if t:visible.append((h,p,t))
    return 1
u.EnumWindows(cb,0)
print("VISIBLE_WINDOWS",visible[:40],flush=True)
print("RUNNER_PID",os.getpid(),flush=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
& python -X utf8 $script
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "foreground diagnostic failed"}
Write-Host "UNC_GUI_FOREGROUND_DIAGNOSTIC=PASS"
